config.question: the stall blend is a partition of unity between an attached branch and a separated one -- how much of each leaks into the other's domain, and what does confining them cost?

candidates.note: the asymmetric family is the two-parameter one: where separation starts, as a fraction of the stall angle, and how far past stall it is complete.  A lower edge at 0 removes the leak at zero incidence by construction but says separation begins at zero incidence, which is not a claim anyone would make; the sweep is what shows whether a lower edge above 0 also clears the criterion.

rollout.note: matches the search's --segment-seconds 8; the base CPG gait, no randomisation, so the sample is the same experiment every time

open_findings: F-05  the logistic did not deliver the attached slope at zero incidence
F-05  the logistic still weighted an unbounded linear branch 10 deg past stall
